keyVerseDR: "Behold the Lamb of God. Behold him who taketh away the sin of the world." (Jn 1:29)

level1.title: The Lamb of God
level1.story: John saw Jesus coming. He said, "Look! The Lamb of God!" The Spirit came down on Jesus like a dove.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you point others to Jesus?
actions: Listen for 'Lamb of God' at Mass
level1.prayer: Lamb of God, have mercy on me. Amen.

level2.title: Behold the Lamb
level2.story: John the Baptist saw Jesus coming toward him. He said, "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!" John said he had seen the Spirit come down from heaven like a dove and stay on Jesus. God had told John that this is the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit. John said, "I have seen and testified that He is the Son of God."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is Jesus called the Lamb of God?
When do we hear these words at Mass?
actions: Pay attention at the Agnus Dei
level2.prayer: Lamb of God, take away my sins. Amen.

activity.title: We say it at Mass
activity.intro: We pray John's words before Holy Communion. Copy them neatly.
activity.text: Behold the Lamb of God, behold Him who taketh away the sin of the world.

art.mainBrief: John the Baptist pointing to Jesus, a little lamb nearby
